notes.title: New gamemode added.
notes.notes:
You can now play and create co-op missions. One mission is available in the game but you can make your own using the scenario editor or download user created ones. (you can find and share scenarios on the discord server https://discord.com/invite/x7KbXEp)

In addition:
Improvements to the Scenario editor
Added option to disable music.
Fixed issue with text chat not working.

notes.title: Scenario editor added to the game.
notes.notes:
The editor allows you to create your own scenarios. Add or remove capture points, spawn positions or change the game type.
The plan for the future is that this editor will also allow for coop missions.
The user interface is not very user-friendly and I hope to improve on that moving forward.

[h2]Sharing[/h2]
Only the host needs to have the scenario files but feel free to share them. There is no workshop integration so this is what you will have to do:
Navigate to where you installed the game. All scenario files are stored in “\SteelCrew\Content\Scenarios\” The ones that comes with the install is called “1default.txt”, “2wakeisland.txt” and “3training.txt”. Let’s say you name your scenario “MyTest” then you should have a “MyTest.txt” file here that you can send. If you want to add a scenario someone else has sent you you will have to add the file here.


[h2]How to use the editor:[/h2]
Scenario name: Set a display name so when hosting you know what you have selected.

Description: A short description of what the scenario is.

Capture points can be added, moved, rotated and scaled. When the game mode is “tug of war” the order they are in will determine in what order they are allowed to be captured in. Each point has a flag that should be placed close to the center of the point.

Ai targets are always connected to a capture point and when playing with bots, this is where they will try to go.

Spawn points can be set to team A or B and the ranks will spawn in the orientation of the spawn point. They should be connected to a capture point if the game mode is “tug of war”. A minimum of 4 spawn points per team is recommended with some space in between.

notes.title: Bugg fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the crew was knocked out to easy

notes.title: Infantry NPCs added
notes.notes:
Hi. Finally back with some updates. I hope I will be able to keep doing more and I’m sorry it’s been so long since the last one.

When capturing a point NPCs will now be spawned to defend the point. This is very much WIP and has not been tested and I expect there to be some issues with performance or replication. The host can turn off the spawning before starting the game if needed.

The bot tanks have also gotten some love and should no longer just charge straight into the point. I hope you like the changes.

notes.title: Training map
notes.notes:
Hello!
A bit of a bigger update this time.
A new map is added to test your driving and shooting skills. There are currently 2 different tracks and one shooting range. (Before you say anything I know the distances on the sights are not correct, this will be addressed)
Also added a soundtrack in the menus by Tim Philippsen https://tphilippsen.carrd.co/

notes.title: Game setting fixes
notes.notes: The game should now respect the Max players, Tank health and Tickets settings.

notes.title: VoIP update
notes.notes:
Hi. After a long time the VoIP should now be back in the game. There are still some features missing (mute, active talkers). 

If it works as it should the plan looking forward is to make a roadmap together with the community on where the focus will be. https://discord.com/invite/x7KbXEp

notes.title: A few more small fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The reset camera position is now saved when changing seats (some issues still present)
[*] Collision fixes on the palm trees on wake island
[*] Ability for the server to not allow in game changing of tanks
[/list]

notes.title: Some small fixes
notes.notes:
Hi. I know it's been a long time since the last update but I hope that I'm finally back to be able to support the game.

Just a small update today but more to come.
[list]
[*] Added the option to not allow spectating when hosting the game.
[*] Abandoned tanks will now stay on the battlefield and will cost the owning team tickets if destroyed.
[/list]

I am working on getting the voip issue solved and are in contact with the team providing it.
Looking forward my plan is to finish the art on the current maps. I want to investigate the possibility of having a co-op gam mode with objectives and obviously better AI. (no promises)

Glad to be back and thank you all who support me by playing and coming with suggestions.

notes.title: Small quality of life update
notes.notes:
Hi, here is another small update.

[list]
[*]Added so the camera now follows the sight when playing as gunner on PC in the Firefly
[*]Indicator is added to the sight to see relative turret rotation
[*]All positions should now have the correct hand models
[*]Voip PTT buttons is now also bound to mouse 4/5 buttons
[/list]

notes.title: Some small tweaks and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hi! A very small update today.
The hitboxes on the t34 turret has been changed and there has also been a few tweaks on the bounce chance of projectiles. 
The AI on the old map should work now again.

notes.title: New map - Wake Island
notes.notes:
I know it has been a long time since the last update but a new map is finally here. It’s still in a blockout stage but should be playable.

The map is 55% scale of the real island and comes with a new gamemode where you will need to capture the points in order.

There have also been some changes across a lot of the base systems that may have caused issues so please report if you find any.

notes.title: Free-cam spectator added
notes.notes:
Hello. Another small update today.
Instead of joining a crew you can now spectate and fly around the map. 

Exit the spectator mode by pressing esc or one of the menu buttons if using motion controllers.

notes.title: Option to lock tanks
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36645596/7f6b16978a3d33049b7d3a29500fa6e11beca94e.png[/img]

Hi. Here comes another small update with some bugfixes, some updated voip support and the ability to lock tanks.
To lock a tank press "L" when in the tank or interact with the switch where it says "Tank Open"
If the light is red other players should not be able to join your tank. 

Have a nice week!

notes.title: Vivox voip integration
notes.notes:
Hi. 

The voip stability has been a big issue since the game was released. 
Vivox is now used instead of steam voice and I hope it will be more stable.

So there is some big changes when it comes to how the voip works.
All crew voip is now proximity based so you can hear other crews when you are close, even enemies. The range is 40 meters.

I hope to add more options like volume control for the voip soon.
Please test this out and let me know how it works. All feedback is welcome!

notes.title: Commander map update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36645596/bd88326337db96e5da42a5275be47da9696e4ae9.png[/img]

Changed so the air support is now called on the map. 
Commanders can now also ping on the map or set markers. The unused slot will be for artillery in a coming update. 

Work has started on the hands but needs more work on skinning, animations and shading.

notes.title: Explosion damage and Chat
notes.notes:
Hello!
I have a few small updates for you guys today.
Explosions can now disable crew members. So be careful when riding with the hatch open.
I have started work on a Chat and Notification system. It’s still WIP and only “All chat” is currently enabled. You will get notifications when someone joins or leaves the server. The plan is to expand it to notify when someone joins/leaves your tank and of course to support team chat.
There is only keyboard support now and to have a VR keyboard is also on the list to fix. This would not be the ideal way of communication but I hope this can be a substitute until I manage to get the VOIP stable. 

The key for all chat is “Y”

Hope you all will have a nice holiday!

notes.title: New aim option added
notes.notes:
Hi! I have added a new option (defaulted to on) that changes how you aim using motion controllers. The pivot of the cranks will now adapt when your hand goes outside of the crank radius.
This should make it a lot easier to aim when not looking at your hands. If you prefer the old way you can disable “Adaptive cranks” in settings.

Have a nice weekend!
/Magnus

notes.title: Small update with controls and VOIP debug
notes.notes:
Hi. You no longer need to look at the steam page for controls. You can now take a look at them before you start playing. 

I am working on getting the VOPI fixed and I have added some extra debug information for that. 
It is a slow process but I have some leads to what the issue is.

Cheers!
/Magnus

notes.title: Steel Crew is now released into early access!
notes.notes:
[h2]A day I have been looking forward to for a long time if finally here![/h2]

This is just the start and all feedback is more than welcome on the Discord or on the steam forum. https://discord.com/invite/x7KbXEp

My focus for the game will be first of all to sort out bugs and finish up the map. Another map is already in the works and hopefully it should not be too long until you can play it.

I also want to thank all of you who took part in the playtests! It has been super helpful and the game would be in a worse state if it wasn't for you.

[h2][h1]Controls[/h1][/h2]
For new players that are playing in VR, I recommend checking the controller setup in the Steam VR bindings.

Camera control when not playing in VR
Look around: Left Alt + Mouse / Right analog stick
Move head side/up/down: MMB + Mouse / [HOLD] Right analog stick + Right analog stick
Move head forward/backwards: Scroll / [HOLD] Right analog stick + Left/Right triggers

Keyboard and mouse
Change position: 1,2,3
Crew voip (Push to talk): G
Menu: Esc
Reset camera: R
Show score: Tab

Driver and commander hatch: F
Driver Drive: WASD
Driver change gear: Q and E

Gunner Main gun: LMB/Space
Gunner MG: RMB
Gunner Aim: Mouse / WASD
Gunner faster aim with mouse: F

Commander Air support: Hold E, Aim, LMB
Commander map: Q
Commander to Commander voip: Space

Gamepad (xbox)
Change position: D-pad forward/left/right
Crew voip (Push to talk): B
Menu: Start
Reset camera: Y
Show score: Back

Driver and commander hatch: X
Driver Throttle/Brake: Right trigger/Left Trigger
Driver change gear: Left bumper/Right bumper

Gunner Main gun: Right trigger
Gunner MG: Left trigger
Gunner Aim: Left analog stick
Gunner full speed turret: Left/Right bumper
Gunner faster aim with mouse: X

Commander Air support: [Hold] Right bumper, Aim, Right trigger
Commander map: Left bumper
Commander to Commander voip: A

notes.title: Steel Crew Playtest
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear tankers, armor geeks and panzer fans![/h3]

We are happy to announce a public playtest planned for the 29th of December, ending on the 1st of January. This is your chance to get in, get down and let loose in highly authentic, meticulously detailed tanks and fight it out against other player crews. So grab your friends and get going - the battle awaits!

[h3]What can you expect from the playtest?[/h3]
You will play the current state of the game. We expect there to be bugs since we have never tested the game as this scale. If you find some, please add report them on discord. 
There is also a lot of art assets that is not done so please be aware of that.

[h3]Sign up and Discord[/h3]
You can sign up at the Steam store page and join our Discord at [url=https://discord.com/invite/x7KbXEp]https://discord.com/invite/x7KbXEp[/url].


[h3]Release moved to 2021[/h3]
The release of Steel Crew has been moved to 2021 in order to implement the feedback from this test properly and to finish building the remaining assets. So this is your chance to help shape the future of online armored warfare!

notes.title: Name change
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and thank you for showing interest in my game.
Work is progressing and I hope to be able to add some videos soon. There is one major change that will happen and that is that unfortunately the name of the game will change.

Once again thank you and I hope to see you all on the battlefield of [b]Steel Crew[/b]!
